title: Jingle Bells

evidence.note: Pierpont copyrighted the song on September 16, 1857, as 'The One Horse Open Sleigh', published by Oliver Ditson & Co. of Boston; it was republished in 1859 as 'Jingle Bells'.

famous_use: Broadcast from space by Gemini VI astronauts Tom Stafford and Wally Schirra on December 16, 1965, using a smuggled harmonica and sleigh bells.
